series.name: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8)
series.notes: Legacy K-control codes (membrane remote fault display + PUH-EK outdoor LED LD1-LD8). Service manual PDF (npcdn mirror) primary, high. Model-scoped separate from A-control (different generations/control types — never merged where meanings diverge).

title.en: Indoor does not respond to remote signal
title.ur: Remote ka signal indoor ko nahi milta

meaning.en: The indoor controller does not respond to the remote controller's signal during individual unit control.
meaning.ur: Indoor controller, individual unit control ke dauran, remote controller ke signal ka jawab nahi deta.

causes.en: Bad contact of the transmission wire
causes.ur: Transmission wire ka contact kharab ho.
Signal transmitting/receiving circuit abnormal ho.

solutions.en: Check the transmission wire and try with another remote controller
solutions.ur: Transmission wire check karein aur doosre remote controller se test karein.

solutions.en: If EO still shows, replace the indoor controller board; if another code appears, replace the original remote
solutions.ur: Agar EO phir bhi aaye to indoor controller board badlein; agar koi doosra code aaye to asal remote badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: K-control writes this as 'EO' (letter O), A-control writes 'E0' (digit zero) — do not merge them.
notes.ur: K-control mein isay 'EO' (letter O) likha jata hai, jabke A-control 'E0' (digit zero) likha jata hai — inhein aik na karein.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): shown as 'EO' on the fault-code display

title.ur: Room temperature thermistor (RT1) mein kharabi (K control)

meaning.en: The room air thermistor RT1 is bad-contact or damaged.
meaning.ur: Room air thermistor RT1 ka contact kharab hai ya yeh kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.ur: Thermistor ka contact kharab ho.
Thermistor damage ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor and measure its resistance — normal is 15 kΩ at 32°F, 9.6 kΩ at 50°F, 6.3 kΩ at 68°F, 4.3 kΩ at 86°F, 3.0 kΩ at 104°F
solutions.ur: Thermistor check karein aur uski resistance naapein — normal 32°F par 15 kΩ, 50°F par 9.6 kΩ, 68°F par 6.3 kΩ, 86°F par 4.3 kΩ, 104°F par 3.0 kΩ.

solutions.en: If resistance is normal, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar resistance normal ho to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: Same physical fault as A-control P1, but defined in the K-control service table.
notes.ur: Yeh A-control P1 wahi physical fault hai, lekin isay K-control service table mein define kiya gaya hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P1' on the fault-code display; S12 K-control LED: 'P1 Intake air sensor abnormal'

title.ur: Indoor coil thermistor (RT2) mein kharabi (K control)

meaning.en: The indoor coil thermistor RT2 is bad-contact or damaged.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil thermistor RT2 ka contact kharab hai ya yeh damage ho gaya hai.

causes.ur: Thermistor ka contact kharab ho.
Thermistor damage ho jaye.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor resistance against the same table as P1
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki resistance P1 wali table se naapein.

solutions.en: If the resistance is normal, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar resistance normal ho to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: S8 gives the check value as 6.4 kΩ @ 20°C for both TH1 and TH2.
notes.ur: S8 dono TH1 aur TH2 ke liye check value 6.4 kΩ @ 20°C deta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P2' on the fault-code display

title.en: Remote does not respond to indoor signal
title.ur: Indoor ka signal remote ko jawab nahi deta

meaning.en: The remote controller does not respond to the indoor controller's signal.
meaning.ur: Remote controller, indoor controller ke signal ka jawab nahi deta.

causes.en: Bad contact of the transmission wire
causes.ur: Transmission wire ka contact kharab ho.
Transmitting/receiving circuit abnormal ho.

causes.en: Wrong operation caused by noise from other appliances
causes.ur: Doosre appliances ki noise ki wajah se ghalat operation ho.

solutions.en: Check the transmission wire and test with another remote controller
solutions.ur: Transmission wire check karein aur doosre remote controller se test karein.

solutions.en: Short-circuit CN40 terminals 1-2 and attach CN40 on twin/triple/group sub units; replace the indoor board if P3 persists
solutions.ur: CN40 terminals 1-2 ko short-circuit karein aur twin/triple/group sub units par CN40 lagayein; agar P3 barqarar rahe to indoor board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: The CN40 jumper requirement in twin/triple/group control is the classic PK fix for P3.
notes.ur: Twin/triple/group control mein CN40 jumper ki zaroorat PK ka classic P3 fix hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P3' on the fault-code display; S12 K-control LED: 'P3 System error (transmitting/receiving signal)'

meaning.en: The drain sensor circuit is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Drain sensor ka circuit open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab ho.
Thermistor/sensor element damage ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the connector and measure resistance between terminals 4-5 (use the P1 table)
solutions.ur: Connector check karein aur terminals 4-5 ke darmiyan resistance naapein (P1 wali table istemal karein).

solutions.en: If the resistance is normal, replace the indoor controller board
solutions.ur: Agar resistance normal ho to indoor controller board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P4' on the fault-code display

meaning.en: The drain pump is not working correctly, or the drain sensor heater circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Drain pump theek se kaam nahi kar raha, ya drain sensor ke heater ka circuit kharab hai.

causes.ur: Drain pump mein malfunction ho.
Drain sensor damage ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the drain pump operation and supply
solutions.ur: Drain pump ki operation aur supply check karein.

solutions.en: Check the drain sensor and its heater — normal resistance should be 82 Ω; replace the indoor board if normal
solutions.ur: Drain sensor aur uska heater check karein — normal resistance 82 Ω honi chahiye; agar normal ho to indoor board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: The 82 Ω drain-sensor heater value is a useful bench check in the field.
notes.ur: Drain sensor heater ki 82 Ω value field mein bench check ke liye kaam aati hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P5' on the fault-code display; S12 K-control LED: 'P5 Drain overflow protecting mechanism'

title.ur: Coil par barf se bachane wali protection chali hai

meaning.en: Frost protection has engaged on the indoor coil (cooling) because of restricted airflow or abnormal refrigerant.
meaning.ur: Hawa ka raasta kam hone ya refrigerant ki kharabi ki wajah se indoor coil (cooling) par frost protection chali hai.

causes.en: Short cycle of the air path
causes.ur: Air path ka short cycle ho.
Air filter ganda ho.
Fan damage/faulty ho.
Refrigerant condition abnormal ho.

solutions.en: Clear obstructions from the air path and clean the air filter
solutions.ur: Air path se rukawatein hatayein aur air filter saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the fan and measure the refrigerant temperature/charge
solutions.ur: Fan check karein aur refrigerant temperature/charge naapein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.ur: Bilkul A-control P6 jaisa hi remediation hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P6' on the fault-code display

meaning.en: The address setting or switch configuration is wrong, producing a system error.
meaning.ur: Address setting ya switch ki configuration ghalat hai, jis se system error aa raha hai.

causes.ur: Address setting ghalat ho.
Remote controller ka transmitting/receiving circuit abnormal ho.
SW6 setting ghalat ho.

solutions.en: Check the address setting and SW6 configuration
solutions.ur: Address setting aur SW6 configuration check karein.

solutions.en: Test with another remote controller; replace the original remote if a different code appears
solutions.ur: Doosre remote controller se test karein; agar koi doosra code aaye to asal remote badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: S8 adds CN40/SW2 to the check list — useful when P7 appears after a board change.
notes.ur: S8 check list mein CN40/SW2 bhi shamil hai — board change ke baad P7 aaye to yeh kaam aata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P7 System error - address setting fault (check CN40, SW2 and SW6)'

meaning.en: The indoor unit detected an abnormality on the outdoor side (wiring, phase, protection device or outdoor coil thermistor).
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ne outdoor side se koi kharabi payi hai (wiring, phase, protection device ya outdoor coil thermistor).

causes.en: Wrong wiring of the indoor/outdoor connecting wire
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor connecting wire ki wiring ghalat ho.
Phase ulti lage ho.
Koi protection device kaam kar raha ho.
Outdoor coil thermistor damage ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the indoor/outdoor connecting wire and correct the phase/wiring connection
solutions.ur: Indoor/outdoor connecting wire check karein aur phase/wiring connection theek karein.

solutions.en: Check the protection device and measure the outdoor coil thermistor resistance; replace the outdoor controller board if normal
solutions.ur: Protection device check karein aur outdoor coil thermistor ki resistance naapein; agar normal ho to outdoor controller board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S10]

notes.en: S10 = outdoor-unit abnormality, S8 = pipe/coil temperature — same code, both readings documented.
notes.ur: S10 = outdoor-unit abnormality, S8 = pipe/coil temperature — wahi code, dono readings document hain.

codes.blinkPattern: S8 P-Series (K): 'P8 Abnormal pipe/coil temperature - no temperature change after 9 minutes of operation'

title.en: Outdoor LED1 — reverse phase on mains (PUH-EK)

meaning.en: On the PUH-EK outdoor unit, LD1 flashing indicates a reverse phase in the mains supply.
meaning.ur: PUH-EK outdoor unit par LD1 blink hone ka matlab hai ke mains supply mein phase ulti hai.

causes.en: Phase rotation of the mains supply is reversed
causes.ur: Mains supply ki phase rotation ulti ho.
Outdoor board ka masla ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Change two phases around and re-power
solutions.ur: Do phases badal kar dobara power dein.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor board if the flash persists with correct phase rotation
solutions.ur: Agar phase rotation theek hone ke baad bhi flash barqarar rahe to outdoor board check karein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

notes.en: LD1–LD8 are outdoor LED positions, not remote-display codes.
notes.ur: LD1–LD8 outdoor LED positions hain, remote-display codes nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD1 flashes for check code, LD1 lit = compressor directive

title.en: Outdoor LED2 — component open circuit / open phase detect
title.ur: Outdoor LED2 — component khula ya open phase

meaning.en: LD2 flashing indicates an open-phase condition or a protection component contact open (CH, 52C, 21S4, SV, 63H, 26C).
meaning.ur: LD2 blink hone ka matlab hai ke phase open hai ya kisi protection component ka contact open hai (CH, 52C, 21S4, SV, 63H, 26C).

causes.ur: Supply mein open phase ho.

causes.en: One of CH / 52C / 21S4 / SV / 63H / 26C open or disconnected
causes.ur: CH / 52C / 21S4 / SV / 63H / 26C mein se koi khula ho ya juda ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the supply for open phase
solutions.ur: Supply mein open phase ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Check each protection component for open circuit or disconnection
solutions.ur: Har protection component ko open circuit ya disconnection ke liye check karein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

notes.en: S8 P-Series (K) wording: 'Component open circuit — check CH, 52C, 21S4, SV, 63H and 26C'.
notes.ur: S8 P-Series (K) ka alfaz: 'Component open circuit — CH, 52C, 21S4, SV, 63H aur 26C check karein'.

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD2 flashes for check code, LD2 lit = heating directive

title.en: Outdoor LED3 — outdoor coil thermistor open/short
title.ur: Outdoor LED3 — outdoor coil ka thermistor open/short

meaning.en: The outdoor coil thermistor is open or shorted, or the outdoor board is faulty.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka thermistor open ya short ho gaya hai, ya outdoor board kharab hai.

causes.en: Outdoor coil thermistor open/short or disconnected
causes.ur: Outdoor coil thermistor open/short ho jaye ya juda ho jaye.
Outdoor control board mein fault ho.

solutions.en: Check and measure the outdoor coil thermistor and its connector
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil thermistor aur uska connector check karke naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor board if the thermistor measures correctly
solutions.ur: Agar thermistor theek naap aaye to outdoor board badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD3 flashes for check code, LD3 lit = during 63H1 operation

title.en: Outdoor LED4 — 63H high pressure switch open
title.ur: Outdoor LED4 — 63H high pressure switch khula

meaning.ur: 63H high pressure switch khul gaya hai.

causes.en: High pressure in the system (blocked coil, fan fault, overcharge)
causes.ur: System mein high pressure ho (coil block, fan fault, overcharge).
63H switch juda ho jaye ya kharab ho.

solutions.en: Investigate the high-pressure causes and clean the coil; check the outdoor fan
solutions.ur: High-pressure ki wajahen dhundein aur coil saaf karein; outdoor fan check karein.

solutions.en: Check the 63H switch connector and continuity
solutions.ur: 63H switch ka connector aur continuity check karein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD4 flashes for check code, LD4 lit = compressor ON

title.ur: Outdoor LED5 — 51CM overcurrent relay ne cut lagaya

meaning.en: The 51CM overcurrent relay has opened because the compressor is locked or drawing too much current.
meaning.ur: 51CM overcurrent relay khul gaya hai kyunke compressor lock ho gaya hai ya bohat zyada current le raha hai.

causes.en: Compressor locked or pulling excessive current
causes.ur: Compressor lock ho jaye ya zyada current le raha ho.
Power supply ka masla ho.

solutions.en: Check the supply voltage and compressor winding resistance
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur compressor winding ki resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Free the compressor / check the relay; replace components only after confirming current is normal
solutions.ur: Compressor ko azaad karein / relay check karein; current normal confirm hone ke baad hi components badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD5 flashes for check code, LD5 lit = outdoor fan ON

meaning.en: The 26C thermal switch has opened (overheat or the switch is disconnected).
meaning.ur: 26C thermal switch khul gaya hai (overheat ya switch disconnect ho gaya).

causes.en: Refrigerant level low causing high discharge temperature
causes.ur: Refrigerant level kam ho jis se discharge temperature zyada ho.
26C switch juda ho jaye.

solutions.en: Check the refrigerant charge and the discharge temperature
solutions.ur: Refrigerant charge aur discharge temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Check 26C continuity and its wiring
solutions.ur: 26C ki continuity aur uski wiring check karein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD6 flashes for check code, LD6 lit = 4-way valve ON

title.ur: Outdoor LED7 — overheat protection, thermistor TH3

meaning.en: Coil/thermistor temperature exceeded the protection limit (67°C) — reduced airflow through the condenser.
meaning.ur: Coil/thermistor ki temperature protection limit (67°C) se zyada ho gayi — condenser mein hawa ka raasta kam ho gaya.

causes.ur: Condenser ka airflow kam ho.

causes.en: Fan motor problem or thermistor problem
causes.ur: Fan motor ka masla ho ya thermistor kharab ho.

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and confirm the outdoor fan runs at full speed
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein aur confirm karein ke outdoor fan poori speed par chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure TH3 resistance and replace the fan motor or thermistor as required
solutions.ur: TH3 ki resistance naapein aur zaroorat ke mutabiq fan motor ya thermistor badlein.

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

notes.en: S8 P-Series (K) LD7: 'Overheat protection — coil temp has exceeded 67°C'.
notes.ur: S8 P-Series (K) LD7: 'Overheat protection — coil temperature 67°C se zyada ho gaya'.

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD7 flashes for check code, LD7 lit = bypass valve ON

title.en: Outdoor LED8 — input circuit fault on the outdoor board
title.ur: Outdoor LED8 — outdoor board ka input circuit kharab

meaning.en: The outdoor board's input circuit is defective.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka input circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective input circuit on the outdoor P.C. board
causes.ur: Outdoor P.C. board par input circuit kharab ho.
External input wiring mein fault ho.

solutions.en: Check the external input wiring and connectors
solutions.ur: External input wiring aur connectors check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor board (S8/S12 both direct board replacement)
solutions.ur: Outdoor board badlein (S8/S12 dono board replacement ki taraf point karte hain).

source.title: K-control legacy codes (membrane remote + PUH-EK outdoor LEDs LD1-LD8) [S12]

codes.blinkPattern: PUH-EK outdoor: LD8 flashes for check code, LD8 lit = crankcase heater ON
